summary: Iter46 verifies three new features: (1) Regime autopilot history import (boot migration regime_history_import_v1), (2) Walk-Forward scope explainer info box in RegimeLab, (3) Export/import/duplicate for dynamic strategies. Backend unit regression: 21/21 in tests/test_dynamic_backup.py + tests/test_autopilot_history_import.py PASS (not live). Broad unit subset (regime/dynamic/boot/retention/autopilot, -m unit): 391/392 passed (1 pre-existing flaky module-import error in test_regime_engine::test_scenario_bank_all_plausible — passes individually; unrelated to this change). New live API suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_live.py (8/8 PASS) covers: GET /api/regime-lab/autopilot/runs?limit=60 contains imp_ra_e866c510 (result.source='import', imported_from.name='9 Regime Krypto 1h Beste Referenzz', grade='sehr gut', regimes=9) and imp_ra_f9ee23d4, plus ca10c03bdd5e and d55aad985cdb; POST /api/regime-lab/autopilot/runs/import idempotent (imported=0); GET /api/dynamic/dyn_bf7d3517/export returns type='dynamic_strategy_backup', dynamic without last_state/pending_switch, analysis.id='ra_e866c510', custom_strategies list and strategy_coin_configs dict; POST /api/dynamic/import rejects invalid body (400), requires admin (401 without token), creates new id with '(Import)' suffix, analysis='exists', settings.auto_check_enabled=False, auto_apply_enabled=False, analysis_id='ra_e866c510', appears in /api/dynamic/list; POST /api/dynamic/dyn_bf7d3517/duplicate creates new id with analysis_id='ra_e866c510'. Cleanup deletes created copies. Frontend (Chromium 1920x1080): Admin login via admin-lock-button + admin-username/password/submit; Tools → tools-menu-regime-lab opens RegimeLab. autopilot-history-section visible, rows autopilot-run-imp_ra_e866c510, autopilot-run-imp_ra_f9ee23d4 render with import label autopilot-run-imported-imp_ra_e866c510 and grade testid autopilot-run-imported-grade-imp_ra_e866c510 text '· Analyse: sehr gut, 9 Regime'; normal rows autopilot-run-ca10c03bdd5e and autopilot-run-d55aad985cdb present. Opening analysis via regime-analysis-row-ra_e866c510 shows WalkForwardScope: regime-wf-scope-combined info box ('Was testet der Walk-Forward?'), toggle regime-wf-scope-toggle-combined expands regime-wf-scope-table-combined with 9 tbody rows containing NNFX Trend / NNFX Mean-Reversion / NNFX Breakout (Herkunft column shows 'Dynamik-Werkbank' for all 9 regimes in this seeded dataset — valid, data-dependent). Finaler Walk-Forward and NNFX-Framework anwenden buttons still render. Dynamic panel (dyn-panel-toggle) exposes dyn-import-btn + dyn-import-input and per-card dyn-export-dyn_bf7d3517 and dyn-duplicate-dyn_bf7d3517.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/dynamic/dyn_{id}/duplicate response is flat {id,name,same_id,analysis,custom_strategies,coin_configs} and omits the created dynamic's settings; UI/scripts must do a follow-up GET /api/dynamic/list to confirm analysis_id. Not a bug, but inconsistent with /import which also returns a flat shape — consider including the created record under a 'dynamic' key for symmetry.

The exported dynamic strips last_state/pending_switch (good). Verify PII/tokens remain stripped if future fields get added — add a schema-level allowlist in services/dynamic_backup.export_bundle to prevent future leaks.

Walk-Forward scope info text is informative but 'Herkunft' column currently shows the same value ('Dynamik-Werkbank') for every row in seeded data; this limits the educational value promised by the review wording. Not blocking — it is data-driven.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 unit + 8/8 live API); 391/392 broader unit (1 pre-existing flaky)

test_credentials: Admin / admin (local core/auth.py defaults, confirmed via /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: No new persistent seeds. Live API test created transient dyn_* strategies and DELETEd them. Post-test /api/dynamic/list shows exactly dyn_bf7d3517 and dyn_0080b023 (originals).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login lives behind data-testid='admin-lock-button' in header (opens modal with admin-username/admin-password/admin-login-submit). RegimeLab is reached via tools-menu-button → tools-menu-regime-lab. To open an analysis use regime-analysis-row-<id> (not just the text). dyn_bf7d3517 is the dynamic linked to analysis ra_e866c510; the dyn_0080b023 (NNFX…) exists in the seed too. Duplicate endpoint returns flat shape (no 'settings' / no 'dynamic' key) — verify via /api/dynamic/list. The /api/regime-lab/autopilot/runs endpoint returns a list directly, each run has result.source='import' for imp_ra_* rows.
